description: Agent Support Operations: submit promise records made in support with the outcomes the records show: the moment the records are read at; each promise with its id, reference, the support ticket, what was promised (an amount, a refund, a credit, a fix, a callback, a deadline or another promise), the promise as the record words it, any amount and currency, the moment it was made and the moment it falls due; each outcome with its id, the promise record it answers, the moment the record shows it done, any amount and a note. The signed report gives the promises and the outcomes, each promise past its due moment against an outcome recorded at all, each first outcome against the promise’s due moment, and the outcomes for each promise added against the amount promised, and counts the promises kept, and names divergent promise records: a promise past its due moment with no outcome recorded at all, a promise kept after its due moment, and a promise kept short of the amount promised; then an outcome above the amount promised and an outcome naming a promise the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A promise not yet due waits; no promises, no reading moment beside a promise with no outcome, or a promise with no due moment and no outcome leaves those points unverified. Promises and outcomes match by letters and digits, the outcomes for one promise add together, amounts compare to the cent and moments to the minute where both carry a time. This reads promise records across the operation against their outcomes: wever_support-brief lists the promises made inside one support conversation, while the promise check reads the promise records across the support operation against what the records show happened. Verdict support_promise_divergent, support_promise_partial, support_promise_unverified or support_promise_consistent. POST /api/support-promise-check. Reads the support records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it answers no customer, sends no message and opens, closes or changes no ticket, which stay with the support team, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Support Operations reads support operation records: ticket logs, first response records, resolution records, escalation records, promise records, performance records, backlog records and the support summary, each against the queue record, the stated response commitments, the customer confirmations, the stated escalation triggers, what the records show happened, the stated service commitments, the ticket list or the records beneath it. The family’s ground is support work already done, read across the whole queue: the DiligenceOps support brief reads one support conversation and lists the promises made in it, and the Agent Feedback family reads the loop around feedback on work, while this family checks whether the support operation’s records hold together across tickets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-support-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-support-operations/.
